title: Florida House, District 118
what_it_does: Represents District 118 (Part of Miami-Dade) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Mike Redondo
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Mike Redondo is a Miami attorney, the son of Cuban immigrants, who won a December 2023 special election for District 118 and was re-elected in 2024. He serves on the House Select Committee on Property Taxes and has been chosen by House Republicans to become Speaker after the 2030 elections.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: Redondo voted for HJR 203 and HJR 1-F in 2026 and campaigns on reducing the property-tax burden on families.
property_tax.quote: Reduce the property tax burden on hardworking families and make government more efficient, transparent, and accountable.

sources.title: Florida House roll call, CS/HJR 1-F (2026 special session), passage 75-26

immigration.summary: Redondo voted for SB 2-C, the 2025 state immigration-enforcement package.

sources.title: Florida House roll call, SB 2-C (2025 special session, immigration), passage 85-30

guns.summary: He voted in 2025 and 2026 for bills lowering the long-gun purchase age from 21 to 18.

sources.title: Florida House roll call, HB 759 (2025, lower long-gun purchase age to 18), passage 78-34

insurance.summary: He sponsored HB 943 (2026), which would bar state-run Citizens from writing commercial coverage and route those risks to a private-market clearinghouse; his site promises a common-sense approach that protects consumers.

candidates.name: Armando Castillo
candidates.background: Armando 'A.C.' Castillo, 55, is the Democratic nominee for the West Kendall district. He holds a labor-studies degree and a union-leadership certificate and reported no campaign fundraising as of mid-2026. He answered the Vote411 questionnaire.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

housing.summary: He supports broader down-payment and rehabilitation assistance, preserving affordable units, rent-increase notice rules, eviction-prevention programs and expanding SHIP and SAIL.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Armando Castillo

abortion.summary: Castillo says he supports a woman's right to choose.
abortion.quote: I support a woman's right to choose

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Armando Castillo

healthcare.summary: He says Florida should accept federal funds and adopt Medicaid expansion.
healthcare.quote: Florida remains one of only 10 states that have not adopted Medicaid expansion.

growth.summary: He says home rule should be respected and the state should be minimally involved in local governance.
